# Issue Triage and Response Guidelines for GitHub Copilot

When responding to, summarizing, or triaging issues in Smart Island:

- **Check Device & OEM Details**: Smart Island's overlay and notification features interact closely with OEM skins (MIUI/HyperOS, OneUI, ColorOS/OxygenOS, EMUI, OriginOS). Check if device model, Android version, and OEM ROM are provided.
- **Identify Issue Category**:
  - *Bug Report*: Verify reproduction steps, logs, and expected vs actual behavior. Check if related to OEM background restrictions or permission loss.
  - *Feature Request*: Align with the product roadmap ([ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/agupta07505/SmartIsland/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)) and core principles (local-by-default, zero tracking, low battery).
  - *Question / Discussion*: Direct to relevant documentation ([README.md](https://github.com/agupta07505/SmartIsland#readme), [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/agupta07505/SmartIsland/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)) or the Telegram Community (`https://telegram.me/SmartIslandApp`).
- **Privacy Assurance**: Remind users not to paste logs or screenshots containing sensitive personal notifications.
